draft_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on five of the six datasets in the tabular suite, with Arbor-GBT higher on Ivel-Fraud.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on r1,r2,r4,r5,r6 but lower on r3 (Ivel-Fraud: 92.3 vs 92.8). "Generally" is defensible given 5/6 wins, but the claim omits the one exception.
